# D7 Labs

> D7 Labs is an independent product studio in Montreal that designs, builds, and ships its own software for learning, faith, and everyday AI. Live products: Ezra (AI learning assistant, iOS and Android), Jack AI (offline on-device AI assistant, iPhone and iPad), Chant d'Espérance (hymnal and Bible reader, iOS and Android), and Sermon to Devotional (a $2.99 pay-per-document web tool).

## About

- **Site**: https://d7labs.dev
- **Legal name**: Laboratoires D7 Inc.
- **Team**: https://d7labs.dev/#team
- **Founder**: Davenson Lombard, senior software engineer (12+ years at MongoDB, Confluent, Ciena) and 18 years in church audio-visual ministry.
- **Based**: Montreal, Canada
- **Languages**: English and French across products; Chant d'Espérance also supports Haitian Creole.

## Products

### Ezra (live)

Personal learning assistant for students and lifelong learners. Record or import lectures, sermons, classes, YouTube videos, audio, and PDFs. Ezra transcribes them, writes a summary and key ideas for each source, answers questions from your own material with source citations, and creates quizzes, flashcards, and study guides. Includes Scripture references and devotionals for sermon notes. One person's private library, not a team platform.

- **Status**: Live on iPhone, iPad, and Android
- **Pricing**: Free, with optional Ezra Plus subscription
- **Languages**: English, French
- **URL**: https://ezrastudio.ai
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798003898
- **Google Play**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.d7labs.ezra

### Jack AI (live)

Private, on-device AI assistant that works offline. Chat, live speech translation, transcription of recordings, text extraction from photos and PDFs, and QR code generation. Once models are installed, prompts, audio, and photos are processed on the device without an internet connection.

- **Status**: Live on iPhone and iPad
- **Pricing**: Free
- **URL**: https://jackai.d7labs.dev

### Chant d'Espérance (live)

Free hymnal and Bible reader app for Haitian and Francophone churches. 9 hymn books, 3 Bible translations, trilingual interface (French, English, Haitian Creole).

- **Status**: Live on iOS and Android
- **Pricing**: Free
- **URL**: https://cesperance.com

### Sermon to Devotional (live)

Web tool for pastors and small-group leaders. Paste a YouTube sermon link or upload a PDF transcript. In minutes, get a scripture-grounded 3-day devotional PDF. Each day contains a hook, scripture passage, reflection (4–6 paragraphs), application, and prayer. Strict scripture-grounding: every sentence must be traceable to the sermon source.

- **Status**: Live
- **Pricing**: Free preview (watermarked), $2.99 to download (PDF or DOCX)
- **No account, no subscription**
- **Languages**: English, French
- **URL**: https://d7labs.dev/tools/sermon-to-devotional
